text: SumUp is a privately held London-headquartered payments company that has raised over EUR 1.5bn in equity and debt from Bain Capital Tech Opportunities, BlackRock, Centerbridge, Crestline, Fin Capital and others. No sovereign or state entity is among the disclosed lead investors, so the Manchester United sleeve is private venture/PE-backed money.
